definitions: A legendary curse said to befall anyone who disturbs the tomb or mummy of the ancient Egyptian pharaoh Ramses II, often associated with misfortune, illness, or death.
examples: Some believe the King Ramses' Curse caused the expedition's misfortunes.
The archaeologist scoffed at the idea of King Ramses' Curse.
Tales of King Ramses' Curse have fascinated people for centuries.
